_help: Values written to the local security policy with secedit. Every number may be changed. Values in this file overwrite the image's current settings.

SystemAccess._MinimumPasswordAge: Days before a password can be changed again. Must be lower than MaximumPasswordAge.
SystemAccess._MaximumPasswordAge: Days before a password expires. 0 means passwords never expire, which CyberPatriot usually penalizes.
SystemAccess._MinimumPasswordLength: Characters. Values above 14 enable 'Relax minimum password length limits' automatically (Windows 10 2004 or later).
SystemAccess._PasswordHistorySize: Number of previous passwords remembered. Maximum 24.
SystemAccess._ClearTextPassword: Store passwords using reversible encryption. 0 = disabled.
SystemAccess._LockoutBadCount: Failed logon attempts before lockout. 0 disables lockout.
SystemAccess._LockoutDuration: Minutes an account stays locked. -1 means until an administrator unlocks it.
SystemAccess._ResetLockoutCount: Minutes before the failed-attempt counter resets. Cannot exceed LockoutDuration.
SystemAccess._ForceLogoffWhenHourExpire: Network security: force logoff when logon hours expire. 1 = enabled.
SystemAccess._LSAAnonymousNameLookup: Network access: allow anonymous SID/name translation. 0 = disabled.
SystemAccess._EnableAdminAccount: Built-in Administrator account. 0 = disabled. Skipped automatically when the script runs as that account.

EventAudit._help: Legacy audit categories. 0 = no auditing, 1 = success, 2 = failure, 3 = success and failure. The advanced subcategories in audit-policy.json are applied afterwards and take precedence.

PrivilegeRights._help: User rights assignment. Each value is a list of SIDs prefixed with *. An empty list means no one. Common SIDs: *S-1-5-32-544 Administrators, *S-1-5-32-545 Users, *S-1-5-32-546 Guests, *S-1-5-32-551 Backup Operators, *S-1-5-32-555 Remote Desktop Users, *S-1-5-19 Local Service, *S-1-5-20 Network Service, *S-1-5-6 Service, *S-1-5-113 Local account, *S-1-5-11 Authenticated Users, *S-1-5-32-568 IIS_IUSRS. Skipped on domain controllers.
PrivilegeRights._SeTrustedCredManAccessPrivilege: Access Credential Manager as a trusted caller
PrivilegeRights._SeNetworkLogonRight: Access this computer from the network
PrivilegeRights._SeTcbPrivilege: Act as part of the operating system
PrivilegeRights._SeRemoteInteractiveLogonRight: Allow log on through Remote Desktop Services
PrivilegeRights._SeDenyNetworkLogonRight: Deny access to this computer from the network
PrivilegeRights._SeDenyBatchLogonRight: Deny log on as a batch job
PrivilegeRights._SeDenyServiceLogonRight: Deny log on as a service
PrivilegeRights._SeDenyRemoteInteractiveLogonRight: Deny log on through Remote Desktop Services
PrivilegeRights._SeRemoteShutdownPrivilege: Force shutdown from a remote system
PrivilegeRights._SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege: Take ownership of files or other objects
